entries.5e952616d059a561: These are services that meet customers' wide-ranging needs, carried out by AIP Consultants Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary in which the Company holds 100% of the equity. They consist of insurance solicitation business and a matching service that acts as a hub of multiple experts to address real estate, inheritance and gifts, business succession, and other matters. In order to concentrate management resources on financial instruments intermediation, its core business, the Company withdrew from the insurance agency business of AIP Consultants by ending new contract solicitation at the end of March 2026. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it accounted for 5.9% of net sales, and was 146.7% of the previous fiscal year.
entries.6b85fb494c4642fe: The company group's only segment, which, centered on financial instruments intermediary services, provides a business platform that lets IFAs (independent financial advisors) concentrate on giving asset management advice. The securities report describes it as divided into two services, "financial instruments intermediary services" and "other financial services." In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥4,584,869 thousand (up 20.7% year on year) and operating profit was ¥110,239 thousand (compared with an operating loss of ¥1,982 thousand in the previous year). At the end of the same period, there were 214 affiliated IFAs, the balance of assets intermediated was ¥429,738 million (up 23.9% from the end of the previous fiscal year), and the total number of accounts related to financial instruments intermediary business was 18,229. As a share of revenue, financial instruments intermediary services were 94.1% and other financial services were 5.9%.

entries.ed343667e5c66831: This is a service the Company provides as a financial instruments intermediary offering a business platform that lets IFAs concentrate on financial advisory work. As of the end of May 2026, the Company has outsourcing agreements and similar contracts with Rakuten Securities, SBI Securities, Akatsuki Securities and Tokai Tokyo Securities, and relays to the securities companies the buy and sell orders for stocks, bonds, investment trusts, etc. proposed by IFAs belonging to 19 IFA offices nationwide. The Company receives from the securities companies, etc. as remuneration a prescribed percentage of the fees, etc. paid to the securities companies according to customers' trading and balance of assets under custody, and pays a prescribed percentage of that to IFAs as remuneration. In addition, it provides IFAs with a business platform including an environment and opportunities for skill improvement, and receives system usage fees in return. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it accounted for 94.1% of net sales, and was 119.4% of the previous fiscal year.
